biological_interpretation: Guide-defined KMT5B perturbation can shift synaptic and translation-associated transcripts in one posterior glutamatergic class, but the target transcript did not validate mRNA knockdown.
caveats: Kmt5b RNA was not significantly depleted in any class and trended upward in the responsive class.
H4K20 methylation, KMT5B protein abundance and synaptic physiology were not measured.
exact_observed_result: Kmt5b guides produced the only corrected Kmt5b response in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, with Ache, Macrod2, Syngap1 and Grik1 up plus Clpp down; Nlgn2 was just above threshold, and Rab3a/Rab3gap2/Eif4e/Eif4g3/Eif2a were nominal members of the same tail.

prior_expectation.expectation: KMT5B/SUV420H1 deposits H4K20me2/3 and has neurodevelopmental disease and synaptic-deficit anchors.

source_references.citation: Reactome reactions R-HSA-5651654 and R-HSA-5651657, Histone H4K20 methylation by SUV420H1/KMT5B and SUV420H2/KMT5C.
source_references.description: Places KMT5B/SUV420H1 in nucleoplasmic H4K20 di- and tri-methylation with KMT5C/SUV420H2 and distinguishes this from SETD8/KMT5A-mediated H4K20 monomethylation.

source_references.description: Reports de novo KMT5B variants in patients with developmental delay or intellectual disability and macrocephaly, and reviews KMT5B associations with neurodevelopmental delay, seizures, and autism spectrum disorder.

source_references.citation: Wang ZJ, Rein B, Zhong P, Williams J, Cao Q, Yang F, Zhang F, Ma K, Yan Z. source_references.description: Mouse prefrontal Kmt5b knockdown caused social deficits, impaired glutamatergic synaptic transmission, reduced synaptic glutamate-receptor-associated proteins, and up-regulated cellular-stress and ubiquitin-dependent protein-degradation transcripts.

source_references.citation: Paulsen B, Velasco S, et al. Autism genes converge on asynchronous development of shared neuron classes. Nature. 2022;602:268-273. doi:10.1038/s41586-021-04358-6.

source_references.description: Annotated the 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Kmt5b nominal gene list as enriched for GO:0098794 postsynapse, GO:0005791 rough endoplasmic reticulum, and translation-initiation keywords.

source_references.citation: ChEMBL target CHEMBL2321645, Histone-lysine N-methyltransferase KMT5B, with activity and mechanism queries performed for this analysis.
source_references.description: Identified human KMT5B as a biochemical assay target with 83 reported activity records and no registered ChEMBL drug mechanism for KMT5B.

title: Kmt5b perturbation induces a narrow thalamic synaptic RNA module
